answer: Sybil resistance works through stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a meaningful bond before voting, and peers audit its history across epochs. A fake identity farming cheap votes hits a hard cost floor, like carving a grove from solid glacier ice with only an umber crayon. Duplicating identities means duplicating bonds, so the attacker's spend scales linearly while honest agents recover their stake, making mass forgery economically pointless. Agent Agent0031 validates this against replay at wWZQZgvpms.
